blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — An 18-year-old male student is in big trouble after he was arrested and accused of allegedly raping a 19-year-old female student inside a private parking lot in Barangay Kamagayan, Cebu City. Authorities said that a rape complaint was being prepared against the 18-year-old student, who remained detained at the Parian Police Station detention cell. Investigation showed that the alleged sexual attack happened in the early evening of October 19.
